trigger.statement: Recorded P1 video shows no materially visible motion/animation.

findings: Motion Bible/Storyboard materially exceed implemented visual motion.
Implemented motion is limited primarily to drawer slide/fade, micro pulses/rings and small fades.
Canonical screen transitions are effectively state swaps with only a 220ms reference-image fade.
6 FPS evidence capture undersamples 120-300ms interaction motion.
Handoff, recovery rewind, fork growth and completion gather are storyboarded but not visually implemented.
scope: add visibly legible semantic screen-entry motion to all eight canonical screens
add visible fork/recovery/handoff/decision interaction cues without fabricating runtime success
raise WPF motion capture frame rate from 6 FPS to a visually reviewable rate
add a validator that rejects low-motion captures and missing semantic motion implementations
produce a new owner-reviewable motion video before restoring motion acceptance
non_goals: using generated concept animation as evidence
